peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 16.8% above its local comparables; 81 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (49.1): 2.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 128 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,300,000 ($1,451 psf, 839–968 sq ft; 9 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,242 psf (range $1,048–1,360); 16.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $187,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Upper Changi MRT about 140 m, Expo MRT about 780 m; closer than 443 of 462 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest East Spring Primary School about 1,090 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 910 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 2,000 m; nearest park Sun Plaza Park about 2,550 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 1,610 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 33 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 22 new sales and 563 resales (585 purchases); new sales were 3.8% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 563 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 143 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 563 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 718 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−21.6%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
